_source: CAQH Roster Individual API Specification v2.0, Table 6: Response for Add to Roster Individual Request Exceptions (page 14)
_classification_rules: Required/Optional/Conditionally Required/Add Failed = fatal. Warning = non-fatal (record was processed despite warning).
required_missing_or_invalid: Required Field missing/invalid: Provider First Name
Required Field missing/invalid: Provider Last Name
Required Field missing/invalid: Provider Address City
Required Field missing/invalid: Provider Address State
Required Field missing/invalid: Provider Address Zip
Required Field missing/invalid: Provider Practice State
Missing Identifiers: At least one of the ID fields (NPI, DEA, UPIN, License State/License Number, SSN) must be populated.
Invalid Identifiers: At least one of the ID fields (NPI, DEA, UPIN, License State/License Number, SSN) must be valid.
optional_invalid: Provider_Fax number is in invalid format
warning_non_fatal: Warning: One or more of the Provider IDs (NPI, DEA, UPIN, License State/License Number, SSN) are invalid; however, record was processed using other valid IDs provided.
conditionally_required: License Number required when License state is populated.
License state required when License Number is populated.
add_failed: Add Failed: Provider is in Opt Out status.
Add Failed: Provider already on Roster (exact duplicate)
Add Failed: CAQH Provider ID not found / invalid
Add Failed: More than one provider matches these criteria. Please use additional data to find a match for this provider or add this provider through the portal.
